newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss to restate GDP data along EU lines.
newsitem.headline: Swiss to restate GDP data along EU lines.

text.p: Switzerland plans to revamp its main economic statistics along European Union lines so that gross domestic product and its components will be restated, the Federal Statistics Office said.
The office will hold a news conference on May 22 to outline the changes, an official said.
"This concerns only the overall economic accounts, the macroeconomic data on gross domestic product and its components," he said. Price and trade data will not be affected.
